# [B109] addendum — the I-114 reseed-twin driver is BIMODAL PER PROCESS; medians across fresh launches
#
# Source: docs/dev/measurements/probe_b109_multilaunch.sh (this commit), run by the
#   manager 2026-09-28 09:22 EDT over the binaries/subjects built by
#   probe_b109_reseed_twin.py's second run (workdir /var/tmp/b109twin-htuo1bxs,
#   bench d0220be, pcrec pin a32bc86e, gcc 15.2.0-16ubuntu1 / clang 21.1.8, -O2).
# Box: budu-ryzen1600 (AMD Ryzen 5 1600, 12 threads), schedutil, ASLR=2; load in the
#   header/footer lines below; pcrecdev1 had nothing running on this box.
# Command: docs/dev/measurements/probe_b109_multilaunch.sh /var/tmp/b109twin-htuo1bxs 15
# Method: every cell is launched as 15 FRESH PROCESSES, each running I-114's own
#   driver with 21 trials and reporting best_us; the line gives min / median / max
#   of the 15 per-process bests, then all 15.
#
# WHY: a second run of probe_b109_reseed_twin.py (same source, same box, ~25 min
#   after the first) did NOT reproduce the first run's per-cell ratios — e.g.
#   asr-lb-fixed/synth-64k-asc/gcc 0.568 -> 1.620, t-64k-cyr 1.00 -> 0.40 — while
#   each run's 21 in-process trials agreed tightly. Repeated launches show why:
#   a process settles into one of TWO stable timing states for its whole life
#   (twin_gcc on synth-64k-asc: 120 us or ~300 us; twin_clang 103 or ~260-317;
#   the zero-candidate 64 KB cells 1.1 or ~2.8 us, BOTH variants). A one-process
#   cell therefore reads a coin flip, and the first archive's
#   "gcc inverts, clang does not" split on synth-64k-asc was the twin landing
#   in its slow state. The cause of the per-process state (subject buffer
#   alignment / ASLR placement is the working suspicion) was NOT isolated.
#
# READING (medians of 15 launches, orig / twin):
#   asr-lb-fixed  synth-dense    gcc 961.6/1005.0 = x0.957 (twin SLOWER; mins agree: 955.9/1003.8)
#                                clang 1027.1/854.6 = x1.20
#   asr-lb-fixed  synth-64k-asc  gcc x1.44   clang x2.97   (NOT inverted)
#   asr-lb-fixed  synth-1m       gcc x1.77   clang x3.17
#   asr-lb-fixed  t-64k-asc      gcc x21.0   clang x43.5
#   asr-lb-varwidth synth-dense  gcc x1.04   clang x1.25
#   asr-lb-neg    synth-dense    gcc x1.42   clang x1.54
#   asr-lb-neg    synth-1m       gcc x12.9   clang x15.0
#   the <3 us cells (zero candidates): parity, bimodal noise in both variants.
# The ONLY reproducible x86 slowdown is asr-lb-fixed on synth-dense under gcc, ~4.5%;
# Mac's x0.81-0.90 is the same direction, larger — Mac's numbers are one process
# per cell too, so they may carry the same state lottery.
#
